versions.changelog:
Initial release of the feature-sunset-plan skill.

- Provides a structured approach to planning and executing the retirement of a product feature.
- Produces a comprehensive sunset plan: decision record, affected-user analysis, migration paths, a staged comms timeline, and a removal checklist.
- Offers clear input requirements, segmenting users by depth and considering contractual and compliance constraints.
- Includes a detailed methodology for user communication, data handling, exception policy, and post-sunset retro.
- Outlines common anti-patterns and quality checks to ensure rigorous, responsible feature sunsetting.
